body: the car jack and clipboard carry the same black paint. a fresh scrape exposes an older evacuation color beneath.
title: Car jack beside the spare mark

body:
The test-plot sample jars lost their labels in the rain. Don't put pesticide samples in the rifle-cleaning tin again; the household still keeps its loose screws there.

The seed-treatment crew left the plot half sprayed and the rows beside it have gone yellow. I scrubbed the tin twice and it still smells sweet.

I stayed until dark in case the crew came back for the jars. No one did.
title: The tin is for screws
